title: Accio Live: free webinars on AI agents for sellers
description: Schedule of free Accio Work live sessions: sourcing, Black Friday images, trend research, Shopify SEO and GEO, Trendyol. Attendees get a $1 Pro promo code, replays and 1:1 onboarding.
lede: Alibaba's Accio Work team runs free 30-60 minute online sessions where AI agents do real seller tasks live. Here is the full calendar, what you get for attending and how to join the next one.
bonuses: $1 promo code for one month of Accio Work Pro
Session replay to rewatch at your own pace
Ready-made professional prompts from the demo

topics.visuals: Turn a phone photo into a 6-image holiday listing kit in under 2 minutes with Visual Factory.
topics.trends: Four agents run market research live: opportunities, customer pain points and data trends.
topics.sites: Build a publish-ready storefront and on-brand marketing emails with autonomous agents.
topics.trendyol: Trendyol Agent, Sourcing Expert, AI Reception and Design Expert for marketplace sellers.
topics.shopify: Buyer-first SEO and GEO playbook so Shopify products show up in Google and AI search.
topics.geo: In-person evening in Barcelona: check what ChatGPT and Gemini say about your business.

steps.title: Pick a session
steps.body: Open the event page and register with your email - all online sessions are free.

steps.title: Bring a real task
steps.body: Prepare a product photo, a niche or your store URL so you can repeat the demo right away.

steps.title: Activate your bonus
steps.body: After the session use the $1 Pro code and book the 1:1 onboarding call.

promptLabel: Prompt to repeat a webinar demo in Accio Work
prompt: Act as my e-commerce operations team. Product: [product]. Market: [country]. 1) Find 5 trending variants with demand signals. 2) Shortlist 3 verified suppliers with MOQ and price. 3) Create a 6-image listing kit for Black Friday and Christmas. 4) Give me a launch checklist with costs.
ctaTitle: Do not wait for the next stream
ctaText: Everything shown in the webinars is available in Accio Work right now - the sourcing agent is free.

faq.a: Yes. Online Accio Live and Accio Work EU sessions are free; you only register with an email.

faq.q: What language are the sessions in?
faq.a: Most are in English; some are held in Spanish, Italian and other European languages.

faq.q: I missed a session. Can I watch it?
faq.a: Registered attendees receive a replay. Accio Live episodes are also streamed on YouTube and Instagram.

sourceNote: Dates and bonuses are taken from official Accio event pages on Luma and Accio posts on LinkedIn. Check the event page for the latest time in your time zone.
